# Installing R Packages {#sec-installing-r-packages}

```{r}
#| include: false
# To trigger auto-linking
library(downlit)
```

We will be using specific R packages for the workshop, so you will need
to install them. The following packages should be installed

``` {.r filename="Console"}

install.packages(c("tidyverse", "shiny", "golem", "plotly","arrow", "here", "bslib","datasets", "duckplyr"))
```
